title: Domain-accurate recovery text for not-found errors by record type
description: BOREAL_NOT_FOUND recovery currently says 'Refresh the work item or queue' even for workflow-doc lookups, which misrouted agents. Key recovery summaries by record domain (work, workflow, summary, evidence, lock).
acceptanceCriteria: Workflow, summary, and evidence not-found errors carry recovery text specific to their record type
Tests cover recovery text per domain
closedReason: Domain-specific not-found recovery text implemented and verified; git checkpoint blocked by sandboxed .git write permissions.
